From 30e9857a134905ac0d03ca244b615cc3ff0a076e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Bjorn Andersson <bjorn.andersson@linaro.org>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2021 11:07:02 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] pinctrl: qcom: Make it possible to select SC8180x TLMM

It's currently not possible to select the SC8180x TLMM driver, due to it
selecting PINCTRL_MSM, rather than depending on the same. Fix this.

Fixes: 97423113ec4b ("pinctrl: qcom: Add sc8180x TLMM driver")
Signed-off-by: Bjorn Andersson <bjorn.andersson@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210608180702.2064253-1-bjorn.andersson@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

diff --git a/drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig b/drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig
index 25d2f7f7f3b6..11e967dbb44b 100644
--- a/drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig
@@ -223,7 +223,7 @@ config PINCTRL_SC7280
 config PINCTRL_SC8180X
 	tristate "Qualcomm Technologies Inc SC8180x pin controller driver"
 	depends on GPIOLIB && (OF || ACPI)
-	select PINCTRL_MSM
+	depends on PINCTRL_MSM
 	help
 	  This is the pinctrl, pinmux, pinconf and gpiolib driver for the
 	  Qualcomm Technologies Inc TLMM block found on the Qualcomm
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig`**
   - The line that previously stated `select PINCTRL_MSM` has been changed to `depends on PINCTRL_MSM`. This modification alters the way the SC8180x pin controller driver interacts with the PINCTRL_MSM configuration, changing it from a selection to a dependency.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification establishes a dependency relationship rather than a selection relationship for the SC8180x pin controller driver with respect to the PINCTRL_MSM configuration. This change allows for better configuration management, ensuring that the SC8180x driver can be selected only if the PINCTRL_MSM is enabled, thus fixing the issue where it was previously not possible to select the SC8180x TLMM driver.

pinctrl: qcom: Make it possible to select SC8180x TLMM

It's currently not possible to select the SC8180x TLMM driver, due to it
selecting PINCTRL_MSM, rather than depending on the same. Fix this.

Fixes: 97423113ec4b ("pinctrl: qcom: Add sc8180x TLMM driver")
Signed-off-by: Bjorn Andersson <bjorn.andersson@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210608180702.2064253-1-bjorn.andersson@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

Here is the root cause:
The SC8180x TLMM driver was incorrectly set to select the PINCTRL_MSM configuration instead of depending on it, which prevented the driver from being selectable when PINCTRL_MSM was not enabled, leading to configuration issues.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
select PINCTRL_MSM
```
Reason:
The use of `select` for `PINCTRL_MSM` means that the SC8180x TLMM driver would always attempt to enable `PINCTRL_MSM` regardless of whether it was configured or not. This creates a situation where the SC8180x TLMM driver cannot be selected if `PINCTRL_MSM` is not enabled, leading to configuration issues.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
depends on PINCTRL_MSM
```
Reason:
Changing `select` to `depends on` allows the SC8180x TLMM driver to be selectable only if `PINCTRL_MSM` is enabled. This ensures that the driver can be configured correctly based on the user's selection, resolving the configuration issues that arose from the previous implementation.
